blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We aim to build a truly unified motion model that can understand, generate, and edit human motion within a single framework. Existing motion UMMs remain only partially unified: motion understanding is handled by a language model, while generation is often delegated to a separate diffusion module operating over learned motion latents. We introduce Möbius, which brings the entire diffusion process into the same multimodal representation space used for motion understanding. Clean motion, noisy motion, and text jointly participate in shared attention, while role-specific parameters process understanding and generation streams. Importantly, Möbius operates directly on continuous frame-level raw motion, requiring neither discrete tokenization nor a pretrained motion VAE. This simple formulation naturally supports motion captioning, text-to-motion generation, temporal completion, and instruction-guided editing within a single model. On HumanML3D, Möbius achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified motion models. Scaling to 1.7B parameters and 1,700 hours of motion data further demonstrates that our framework is both effective and scalable.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是建立一个真正统一的运动模式,能够在单一的框架内理解、产生和编辑人类的运动。 现有的运动UMM仍然只有部分统一:运动理解是由语言模型处理的,而生成常常被下放到一个单独的扩散模块,运行在学习的运动潜伏上. 我们介绍Möbius,它把整个传播过程带入同一个用于理解运动的多式联运代表空间。 干净的运动,吵闹的运动,和文字共同参与共同关注,而特定角色的参数会过程理解和生成流. 重要的是,Möbius直接运行在连续的帧级生动运动上,既不需要离散的标注,也不需要预先训练的运动VAE. 这种简单的配方自然支持在一个单一模型内进行运动标题,文字到动作生成,时间完成,以及指令引导编辑. 在HumanML3D上,Möbius在统一运动模型中实现了最先进的性能. 放大到1.7B参数和1 700小时的运动数据进一步表明,我们的框架既有效又可扩展。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Unifying understanding and generation within a single model is a central goal of multimodal intelligence, including motion-language modeling. Existing approaches have largely followed two paradigms. Diffusion-based methods ( Tevet et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) excel at high-fidelity motion generation but typically lack native motion understanding capabilities. In contrast, language-model-based approaches ( Guo et al., 2022b ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) unify multiple motion–language tasks autoregressively, but struggle in generation quality. This gap motivates a unified model that excels at both understanding observed motion and generating high-fidelity motion from natural-language instructions.
blocks.zh: 在一个单一模式内统一理解和生成是包括运动语言建模在内的多式联运智能的核心目标。 现行办法基本上遵循两种模式。 基于传播的方法(Tevet等人,2022年;Chen等人,2023年;He等人,2026年;Wen等人,2025年)在高纯度运动生成方面表现优异,但通常缺乏本土运动理解能力. 相比之下,基于语言模式的方法(Guo等人,2022b;Jiang等人,2023;Wu等人,2025b)自动统一了多种运动-语言任务,但在生成质量方面挣扎。 这种差距促使一种统一的模型在理解观察运动和从自然语言指令中产生高度的真伪运动上表现优异.

blocks.en: Recent unified motion–language models have attempted to unify motion understanding and generation ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) (see Fig. 2 for an architectural comparison). In these approaches, the language model first produces a shared multimodal representation, which is then passed as conditioning to an external diffusion model for motion generation. While this design allows understanding and generation to interact through a common feature space, the actual denoising process remains largely separated from the language model. The unified representation specifies what motion to generate, but does not directly participate in how the motion is progressively constructed. Consequently, motion understanding and motion generation are only partially unified. This motivates a more tightly integrated formulation in which not only the conditioning representation, but also the diffusion process itself operates within the unified multimodal feature space. We therefore ask: Can motion understanding and the entire motion generation process be unified within a single representation space?
blocks.zh: 最近的统一运动-语言模型试图统一运动理解和生成(Zhu等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)(建筑学比较见图2). 在这些方法中,语言模型首先产生一种共享的多式联运代表,然后作为运动生成的外部传播模型的条件。 虽然这种设计允许理解和生成通过一个共同的特征空间进行交互,但实际的去诺过程仍然在很大程度上与语言模型分离. 统一代表制规定了产生何种运动,但并不直接参与运动如何逐步构建. 因此,运动理解和运动生成只是部分统一。 这促使一种更为紧密的一体化的表述方式,其中不仅具有条件性,而且传播过程本身也在统一的多式联运特征空间内运作。 因此,我们问:能否在一个单一的代表空间内统一理解动议和整个动议生成过程?

blocks.en:
To address this question, we introduce Möbius , which brings the entire motion diffusion process into the same unified representation space as motion understanding. Both clean motion for understanding and noisy motion under generation are represented as motion tokens and jointly participate in the same attention with language tokens. Inspired by the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) ( Liang et al., 2024 ) design, we use dedicated parameters to process clean and noisy motion streams while allowing them to communicate through shared attention.
As a result, motion generation is no longer performed by an external diffusion module conditioned on features produced by the language model. Instead, noisy motion is progressively denoised directly within the unified multimodal space, where it can continuously interact with clean motion and language semantics. The generated motion can in turn be fed back as clean motion tokens for subsequent understanding and reasoning, forming a fully unified loop between motion generation and understanding. This tighter integration leads to stronger motion generation, understanding, and cross-modal interaction within a unified model.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们介绍Möbius, 这使得整个运动传播过程与运动理解一样进入同一个统一代表空间. 为了理解而提出的清洁动议和一代人的吵闹动议都以运动符号为代表,并以语言符号共同参与同样的关注。 在Mixture-of-Transfers(MOT)(Liang等人,2024年)设计的启发下,我们使用专用参数处理干净而吵闹的运动流,同时允许它们通过共同关注进行交流.
因此,以语言模型生成的特性为条件的外部传播模块不再进行运动生成. 相反,噪音运动在统一的多式联运空间内被逐渐直接去除,在那里它能够与干净的运动和语言语义不断相互作用. 生成的运动又可以被反馈回作为清洁的运动符号,用于后续的理解和推理,在运动生成和理解之间形成一个完全统一的循环. 这种更紧密的结合导致在一个统一的模型内更强大的运动产生,理解和跨模式互动.

blocks.en: A key advantage of this formulation is that it removes the need to learn an intermediate motion latent space. Rather than relying on a pretrained motion VAE, tokenizer, or task-specific encoder ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , Möbius operates directly on raw motion representations. Clean motion used for understanding and noisy motion used for generation share the same representation interface: both are projected into the unified multimodal space, with their roles distinguished only by whether they represent clean observations or noisy states undergoing denoising. This makes motion understanding and generation two modes of computation over the same underlying motion representation, rather than two tasks connected through separately learned latent spaces. The resulting framework is considerably simpler, requiring no additional representation learning stage or pretrained motion encoder, while our experiments show that directly modeling raw motion is sufficient to achieve strong performance for both understanding and generation.
blocks.zh: 这种提法的一个关键优点是,它消除了学习中间运动潜在空间的需要。 莫比乌斯不依靠预先训练的运动VAE,标注器,或任务特定编码器(Jiang等人,2023年;Zhu等人,2025年;Xiao等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年),直接操作于原始运动表达. 用于理解和用于生成的噪音运动的清洁运动共用同一表示界面:两者都投射到统一的多式联运空间中,其作用只区分于它们是否代表清洁观测或正在消音的噪音状态。 这使得运动理解和生成两种模式的计算都基于相同的运动表现,而不是通过单独学到的潜伏空间来连接两个任务. 由此形成的框架要简单得多,不需要额外的表现学习阶段或预先训练的运动编码器,而我们的实验表明,直接建模原始运动就足以实现对理解和生成的强效.

blocks.en: To preserve the generalization ability of the pretrained LLM used in Möbius , we adopt a curriculum training strategy. Joint training can introduce interference between understanding and generation, as gradients from the generation objective can propagate into the understanding parameters through shared attention. We therefore first train on motion understanding tasks, allowing the LLM to acquire meaningful motion semantics, and then introduce the generation objective on top of this learned representation. This curriculum training strategy provides a stable foundation for generation while better preserving the model’s original generalization ability.
blocks.zh: 为了保持Möbius所使用经过预先培训的LLM的普及能力,我们采取了课程培训战略。 联合培训可以引入理解和生成之间的干扰,因为生成目标的梯度可以通过共同关注传播到理解参数中。 因此,我们首先对运动理解任务进行训练,让LLM获得有意义的运动语义学,然后在这个博学的表述之上引入生成目标. 这种课程培训战略为一代人提供了稳定的基础,同时更好地维护了模型最初的普及能力。

blocks.en: We evaluate two model variants to assess benchmark performance and the benefits of scaling model capacity and training data. Under the HumanML3D evaluation protocol ( Guo et al., 2022a ) , Möbius -0.6B achieves state-of-the-art results in both text-to-motion generation and motion captioning, outperforming relevant diffusion-based, language-model-based, and motion–language baselines. Möbius -0.6B also demonstrates strong capabilities in motion completion, motion in-betweening, and instruction-guided editing. Controlled ablations substantiate the effectiveness of our reasoner–generator architecture, showing that coupling motion understanding and generation yields improvements over commonly used architectural alternatives. We further present Möbius -1.7B, a larger variant trained on 1,700 hours of high-quality motion data, which delivers additional improvements across all motion-language tasks on both controlled and uncontrolled user inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个模型变体,以评估基准业绩以及扩大模型能力和培训数据的好处。 Möbius - 0.6B在HumanML3D评价协议(Guo et al., 2022a)下, Möbius - 0.6B还显示出在运动完成、运动介于之间以及指导编辑方面的强大能力。 受控的冲动证明了我们理性-生成结构的有效性,表明结合运动的理解和生成比常用的建筑替代方法有改进。 我们进一步介绍Möbius -1.7B,这是一个较大的变体,训练了1,700小时的高质量运动数据,在受控和不受控制的用户输入的所有运动语言任务中都带来了额外的改进。

blocks.en: 3.1 Frame-level raw motion representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架一级的原始动议陈述

blocks.en:
In our framework, we choose frame-level raw motion as the motion representation instead of learning any additional motion encoder.
In previous methods, discrete motion tokenizers introduce quantization error ( Guo et al., 2022b ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) , while VAE-based approaches
compress motion to temporally downsampled latents ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , losing frame-level information. Instead, we follow HY-Motion ( Wen et al., 2025 ) to represent a motion clip as X = [ x 1 , … , x T ] ⊤ ∈ ℝ T × D X=[x_{1},\ldots,x_{T}]^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times D} with motion token dimension D = 201 D{=}201 comprising joint positions and rotations. Special tokens ⟨ BOM ⟩ \langle\mathrm{BOM}\rangle and ⟨ EOM ⟩ \langle\mathrm{EOM}\rangle are used to delimit the motion token sequence from text. Two dedicated projectors map clean motion tokens and noisy motion tokens to the shared representation space for understanding and generation, and corresponding motion heads decode it back to the raw motion space. In comparison with existing methods ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) that learn different encoders for understanding and generation, we show that the raw motion representation can achieve strong performance in a unified representation space.

blocks.en: 3.2 Unified feature space attention with MoT
blocks.zh: 3.2 与 MoT 统一特性空间关注

blocks.en: To process all the clean or noisy raw motion and text prompts, we adopt a Mixture-of-Transformers ( Liang et al., 2024 ) structure. In MoT, tokens are routed to different parameters for normalization and linear projection but are then processed by a unified attention operation. We introduce how we route different tokens, and then we discuss how to conduct generative denoising.
blocks.zh: 为了处理所有干净或吵闹的原始动作和文字提示,我们采用了变节者混合(Liang等人,2024年)结构. 在MOT中,令牌被路由到不同的参数,用于正常化和线性投影,但随后通过统一的注意操作处理. 我们介绍我们如何引导不同的信物, 然后我们讨论如何进行基因解密。

blocks.en:

blocks.en: In our design, motion token attention follows a different bidirectional visibility pattern from the causal attention of autoregressive text tokens. Specifically, we allow all motion tokens within the same motion sequence to attend bidirectionally to one another, regardless of whether they represent clean motion for understanding or noisy motion for generation. For understanding, the entire observed motion is already available as input, so bidirectional attention enables each frame to capture context from the complete motion sequence. For generation, all noisy target frames are instantiated jointly at each denoising step, and bidirectional attention allows each frame to exploit both past and future temporal context during refinement. Text tokens, in contrast, retain the causal attention pattern of the pretrained language model. In implementation, the target generated motion sequence is always put at the end of the whole sequence with its generation sequence length specified before denoising, allowing the full noisy sequence to be progressively refined as a whole.
blocks.zh: 在我们的设计中,运动符号的注意跟自递式文字符号的因果注意不同的双向可见度模式. 具体地说,我们允许在同一运动序列中的所有运动符号以双向方式互相配合,无论它们代表的是理解的清洁运动还是一代的吵闹运动. 为了理解,整个观测到的运动已经作为输入提供,所以双向的注意使每个帧能够从完整的运动序列中捕捉上下文. 对于一代人来说,所有吵闹的目标帧都会在每一个调试步骤上共同被即时化,双向的注意可以让每个帧在完善过程中同时利用过去和将来的时间背景. 相比之下,文本符号保留了预训语言模型的因果关注模式. 在执行中,目标生成的运动序列总是被置于整个序列的末端,其生成序列长度在解密前指定,从而可以使全响的序列在整个过程中逐渐完善.

blocks.zh: 3.3 课程培训战略

blocks.en: We train Möbius in two stages. Directly optimizing motion understanding and generation together is unstable, as the randomly initialized generation pathway can disrupt the pretrained language representations and degrade the model’s understanding ability. We therefore adopt an understanding-first training strategy: the model first learns to interpret motion in the language space, and generation is introduced only after this representation has been established.

blocks.en: The same framework naturally extends to a broad range of motion editing and completion tasks by treating the source motion as part of the conditioning context and generating the desired target motion. We also train our model on these tasks. Depending on which parts of the source are observed, the model supports temporal completion, including prediction, backcasting, in-betweening and keyframe infilling. It also supports semantic editing, where a source motion is modified according to a natural-language instruction. In all cases, the observed source motion is encoded as clean context, while the generation process predicts the missing or edited target motion. We construct diverse training pairs covering these settings and jointly train a unified editing model without introducing task-specific architectures.
blocks.zh: 同样的框架自然延伸至广泛的运动编辑和完成任务,将源运动作为条件上下文的一部分,并产生期望的目标运动. 我们还就这些任务培训我们的模式。 该模型取决于观察源的哪些部分,支持时间完成,包括预测、反射、介于中间和键框填充。 它还支持语义编辑,即根据自然语言指令修改源动. 在所有情况下,观测到的源运动被编码为干净上下文,而生成过程则预测缺失或编辑的目标运动. 我们建造了涵盖这些环境的多种培训组合,并联合培训一个统一的编辑模型,而不采用特定任务架构。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , Möbius -0.6B outperforms both generation-specialized and unified baselines trained on HumanML3D. The scaled Möbius -1.7B also achieves strong performance against large-scale motion models, attaining the best R-Precision, FID, and MMDist among the compared methods. For motion understanding, Möbius consistently outperforms existing unified motion-language models across all reported metrics (Table 2 ). Furthermore, Möbius surpasses editing-specialized baselines and even the unedited source motion (Table 3 ), demonstrating strong instruction-following capabilities.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,Möbius -0.6B在HumanML3D方面训练的一代专门化和统一基线方面都超过业绩。 缩放的Möbius -1.7B也实现了对大型运动模型的强性能,在比较方法中达到了最好的R精度,FID和MMDist. 就运动理解而言,Möbius在所有报告的指标中一贯超越现有的统一运动语言模型(表2)。 此外,Möbius超越了编辑专业基线,甚至超越了未经编辑的源动(表3),显示出强大的遵循指令的能力。

blocks.en: We attribute our advantages in motion generation to the unified architecture. The routing scheme brings the entire motion diffusion process into the shared representation space, allowing the semantics of clean motion and language to continuously guide generation. Meanwhile, the curriculum training strategy helps preserve the reasoning ability inherited from the pretrained LLM, resulting in strong motion-understanding performance. Together with the frame-level raw motion representation, these designs also enable framewise control and editing that follow language instructions well, improving performance across motion–language tasks without sacrificing one capability for another.
blocks.zh: 我们把运动生成的优势归结于统一的建筑. 路由方案将整个运动扩散过程带入共享的表达空间,使得清洁运动和语言的语义能够不断引导生成. 同时,课程培训战略有助于保留从经过预先培训的LLM中继承的推理能力,从而产生强大的运动理解性能. 这些设计与帧级原始运动表现法一起,还能够很好地按照语言指示进行帧控制和编辑,改善各种运动语言任务的性能,同时又不牺牲一种能力。

Which motion encoding best supports unified modeling? We compare three representative motion interfaces in IDs 1, 2, and 10.
Since discrete VQ tokens do not naturally represent intermediate continuous
denoising states, the VQ variant uses dense computation, whereas the VAE and

frame-level modeling provides the strongest balance between the two
capabilities. Moreover, its one-to-one correspondence between motion frames and
model positions naturally supports temporal completion and frame-conditioned
manipulation.

blocks.en:
How should understanding be transferred to generation? IDs 6–10 further isolate how learned motion–language understanding benefits
generation. Compared with generation-only training (ID 6), the full model
(ID 10) shows that establishing motion–language understanding first provides a
stronger foundation for synthesis. Joint optimization (ID 7) notably degrades
understanding, revealing interference between the two objectives when optimized
together. Restricting denoising to only the final-layer context representations
(ID 8) also weakens generation, demonstrating the benefit of layer-wise
interaction throughout the denoising process. Randomly initializing the
denoising parameters (ID 9) further degrades performance relative to
initialization from the parameters learned during understanding. Together,
these results support our understanding-first strategy: first establish
motion–language alignment, then transfer it to generation through parameter
initialization and layer-wise interaction while keeping the learned
understanding parameters fixed.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We presented Möbius , a unified motion–language model that organizes computation by role rather than modality. Its role-routed architecture and continuous frame-level motion interface support motion understanding, generation, editing, and temporal completion within a single unified framework. The results also highlight the benefit of transferring learned motion understanding to generation. Experiments on HumanML3D show strong T2M and M2T performance, while scaling to 1.7B parameters and 1,700 hours of motion data further demonstrates the effectiveness of the design at larger scale.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Möbius, 一个统一的运动语言模式, 它的角色序式架构和连续帧级运动界面支持在一个单一统一框架内的运动理解,生成,编辑,以及时间完成. 结果还突出了将学到的动作理解转移给一代的好处。 关于HumanML3D的实验显示强大的T2M和M2T性能,而缩放到1.7B参数和1700小时的运动数据进一步证明了设计在更大尺度上的有效性.

blocks.en: More broadly, Möbius demonstrates that understanding and continuous motion generation need not be connected through a separate latent generator, but can instead operate together within a shared multimodal representation space. Our current experiments focus on controlled single-person motion settings. Future work will extend Möbius toward multi-person interaction, more detailed hand and finger motion, retargeting across heterogeneous body structures, and deployment in embodied systems such as real-world robots.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,Möbius表明,理解和连续运动生成不需要通过单独的潜在生成器来连接,而是可以在共同的多式联运代表空间内共同运作。 我们目前的实验集中在受控制的单人运动设置上. 未来的工作将把Möbius扩展至多人互动、更详尽的手和手指运动、跨不同身体结构的重定向,以及部署在诸如现实世界机器人等体现的系统中。

Table S8 compares the main-table 0.6B model
with the multi-task variant after 20k continuation steps. Adding conditional
generation tasks yields a modest T2M trade-off: R@1 decreases by 1.53
percentage points, FID increases from 6.1291 to 6.6746, and MMDist increases
from 13.9973 to 14.0824. Nevertheless, the multi-task model still outperforms
all other HumanML3D-trained methods in Table 1 on R@1–3, FID,
and MMDist, including generation-specialized models. Its M2T scores remain
identical to the main-table results, consistent with keeping the understanding
parameters frozen during the additional generation training.

blocks.en:
The main-table comparison focuses on the bidirectional T2M/M2T setting shared
with unified motion–language baselines, reducing the influence of additional
task-specific supervision on that comparison. The multi-task evaluation asks
a complementary question: can the same architecture accommodate additional
observation patterns and conditional generation objectives while retaining
its core capabilities? The temporal-completion results, together with the
strong T2M scores and unchanged M2T performance, support this broader task
coverage without introducing task-specific generation modules. We therefore
report the variants separately to make the trade-off between task breadth
and T2M specialization explicit. This demonstrates extensibility across
trained tasks, rather than establishing zero-shot generalization to unseen
tasks or distributions.
